query:
SELECT
                m.id                                  AS "id!: uuid::Uuid",
                m.csam_trained                        AS "csam_trained!: bool",
                m.calibration_complete                AS "calibration_complete!: bool",
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint
                    FROM incidents i
                    WHERE i.assigned_to = m.id
                      AND i.status IN ('open', 'in_review')
                ), 0)                                 AS "current_load!: i64"
            FROM moderators m
